verdict.rationale: Graphite's official docs explicitly state AI features are opt-in and that neither Graphite nor its subprocessors (Anthropic, OpenAI) use customer data to train models, backed by contractual prohibitions. This directly addresses the story's ask, though there's no independent/third-party audit confirming the claim. Missing for 10: independent verification/audit of the no-training claim, and details on opt-out mechanics or enforcement.
